channel.title: Projects on Tej Karanam
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on Tej Karanam

item.title: Plagiarism Checker
item.description: Paste an essay or upload a file. It searches the web for each passage and highlights every copied phrase with a link to where it came from.

item.title: Food Calorie Detection
item.description: A desktop app that finds food in a photo with YOLO and estimates the calories. Python, Tkinter, and a nutrition lookup table.

item.title: Recap
item.description: Drop in a lecture or meeting. It writes the notes, quizzes you, makes spaced-review flashcards, answers questions with timestamps, and cuts the best moments into vertical clips, all inside your browser.

item.title: Eco-Sort
item.description: Point a camera at a piece of trash and it tells you Recycling, Compost, or Landfill, live in the browser.

item.title: nanoGPT from Scratch
item.description: A character-level GPT built from the ground up in PyTorch. A bigram baseline, then the full Transformer, trained to write fake Shakespeare.
